description: Sizzler combines mutation-based sequential generative-adversarial fuzzing with modified QEMU GPIO and I2C emulation to evaluate PLC ladder programs. The source documents 30 LDmicro/OpenPLC programs compiled for five microcontrollers, establishing an implemented simulation of industrial-control equipment.
